description: This file defines the BiAnnualCompoundingPeriod class, which implements interest calculation logic for bi-annual periods within a savings account management system. It includes methods for calculating interest based on daily or average daily balances, handling different interest periods, and managing end-of-day balance data.

classes.name: BiAnnualCompoundingPeriod
classes.description: Represents a bi-annual interest compounding period with methods to calculate interest based on various parameters, using end-of-day balances within the period.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of BiAnnualCompoundingPeriod within a specified date interval and balance data.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest for the period based on the given interest calculation type and parameters.

methods.name: calculateUsingAverageDailyBalanceMethod
methods.description: Calculates interest based on the average daily balance over the period.

methods.name: calculateUsingDailyBalanceMethod
methods.description: Calculates interest based on the daily or monthly balance data, considering the period's interest compounding type.

methods.name: endOfDayBalancesWithinPeriodInterval
methods.description: Filters and retrieves end-of-day balances within the specified date interval for interest calculation.
